title: plugin-audit: a comment written while impersonating writes no audit or activity row, so it can't be told from the employee's own (#30213 comments fork, ruling A)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Filing gate: **③ a task on the maintainer's word.** Card #30213 (closed by PR #30800) left one fork with the maintainer: its os-dev-report (6676374251) asked how comments should carry the impersonation stamp. The maintainer chose option **A**, 「A 评论也记审计和动态」, on the seat's decision card on 2026-11-06.

## 维护者速读

管理员模拟员工时写的普通记录，审计和动态里已经会记「谁代谁」(#30800)。评论不行:`sys_comment` 在审计镜像的跳过名单里，模拟时写的评论和员工本人写的完全一样。按你选的 A:不再跳过评论，评论也写审计和动态两行，带上同一个模拟标记。代价是每条评论多两行。

## Today

- `sys_comment` is in plugin-audit's `SKIP_OBJECTS`, so a comment write produces no `sys_audit_log` row and no `sys_activity` row (reported in 6676374251).
- PR #30800 stamps `sys_audit_log.metadata.impersonated_by` and `sys_activity` `impersonated_by` / `impersonated_by_name` from `ExecutionContext.impersonatedBy` on every other mirrored write.

## Expected (ruling A)

- Comments leave `SKIP_OBJECTS`. A comment insert, update and delete writes the same ledger and activity rows as every other mirrored write. A write made while impersonating carries the impersonation stamp PR #30800 added.
- No new column and no migration. Option B, a column on `sys_comment`, was not chosen.
- Measure first whether a comment activity row duplicates an existing comment feed entry in the console timeline; if it does, say how the timeline shows it, and stop if a ui change is needed.
- Read visibility: an audit or activity row for a comment must not show the comment to a reader who cannot read its parent record. Reuse the existing read-visibility rules; don't add a second judgment.

## Acceptance

- Tests:
  - an impersonated comment insert writes an audit row and an activity row, both stamped with the administrator;
  - CONTROL: a non-impersonated comment writes both rows unstamped;
  - a reader without read access to the parent record does not see the comment's rows.

Suggested grade: p3 · S · `domain:server` (plugin-audit). Dedupe: this card is the only carrier of the #30213 comments fork.
